svg.title: From a sentence, a voice note or a receipt photo to a saved record
svg.desc: Three input paths (text, voice, receipt photo) plus a manual form. Text and voice go through a prompt, an external LLM and a rules check. A receipt photo is shrunk in memory, read by a vision LLM and sanitized. All AI paths end in a short-lived draft proposal that the user reviews, then a validated atomic save into the PostgreSQL ledger. The manual form uses the same save.

svg.text: What happens between your input and the ledger, and what keeps it safe

g.text: Always available, and the fallback if the AI is down
No AI involved. Same validated save.
After this step, voice follows the text path:
the transcript is sent as if you had typed it.

items too for receipts. Kept for 24 h.
Accept (one tap when the AI is confident),
Edit, or Discard. An unclear message gets
Same services as the manual forms:
Transaction + signed movements. Balance is derived.
The AI only proposes. It never saves anything.
The prompt carries only your own account and category names.
Text from messages and photos is treated as untrusted.
Voice audio is recognized on the device, never uploaded.
Receipt photos are processed in memory, never stored.
If the AI or a provider fails, the manual form still works.
